explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the optimal objective drops from 1146.5665 to 568.4220 by tracing the exact code changes that implement the business brief’s “gate” and “shared skilled-operator desk.” Your answer must name the new decision variable `z_B2`, the new constraints `b2_activation_link` and `shared_labor_pool`, and connect them to the exact `general_parameters.csv` fields `b2_activation_fee`, `shared_labor_hours`, and at least one `labor_coeff_*`, plus the `table_1.csv` columns used in the B2 linkage and labor accounting. Then use the revised LP-relaxation duals/slacks to identify which constraints are binding, interpret the shadow price of `shared_labor_pool` and `b2_activation_link` in business terms, and explain why that marginal interpretation cannot be linearly extrapolated to predict the full MIP objective change once B2 is switched off in the integer optimum.
